description: This file defines the LeaveParameterObject class within the OrangeHRM leave management system. The class encapsulates parameters for leave requests, including employee number, leave type, date range, comments, and leave durations, along with handling multi-day and partial leave options.

classes.name: LeaveParameterObject
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class to represent leave parameters such as employee ID, leave type, date range, comments, and specific multi-day/partial day options. It includes validation and utility methods for managing leave-related data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with employee number, leave type, start date, and end date, setting the basic leave parameters.

methods.name: isMultiDayLeave
methods.description: Determines whether the leave spans multiple days by comparing fromDate and toDate.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the leave request.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the leave request.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Returns the leave type ID.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the leave type ID.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the leave.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the leave.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the leave.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the leave, ensuring it is after the start date.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the optional comment associated with the leave.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets an optional comment for the leave.

methods.name: getSingleDayDuration
methods.description: Returns the leave duration for a single-day leave; throws exception if called for multi-day leave.

methods.name: setSingleDayDuration
methods.description: Sets the leave duration for a single-day leave.

methods.name: getStartMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Returns the start multi-day leave duration, with validation for partial options.

methods.name: setStartMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Sets the start multi-day leave duration, validating partial options and duration type.

methods.name: getEndMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Returns the end multi-day leave duration, with validation for partial options.

methods.name: setEndMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Sets the end multi-day leave duration, validating partial options and duration type.

methods.name: getMultiDayPartialOption
methods.description: Returns the partial option for multi-day leave, valid only for multi-day leaves.

methods.name: setMultiDayPartialOption
methods.description: Sets the partial day option for multi-day leave, validating allowed values.

methods.name: checkDurationTypeForMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Validates that the multi-day duration is not a full-day type when used with multi-day leave.

methods.name: checkMultiDayPartialOption
methods.description: Validates that the partial option is appropriate for multi-day leave.
